facts.text: The party must bring metal from the Dwarven mine to Warwick the smith in exchange for the loan of his mithril chain shirt. Warwick keeps Sir Phidipaldi's lyre to use every night meanwhile and holds the party's plate armor as collateral.
Wayman wears Warwick's mithril chain shirt, on loan under the deal. It was Warwick's grandfather's heirloom armor, greatly improves protection and halves damage from magic weapons and spells.
A cave-in seals the Dwarven mine entrance, blocking the party from getting metal for Warwick. It looks natural and can be dug through; Dunk has begun breaking into it.
